politics.government: Government led by Sébastien Lecornu; no stable parliamentary majority in the National Assembly.
politics.opposition: Main opposition blocs include the National Rally and parties of the left.
politics.nationalElection: Presidential election: 18 April 2027; second round 2 May 2027.

politics.support: Minority coalition; the government has relied on additional parliamentary support from regional parties.
politics.opposition: Main national opposition: PP and Vox.
politics.regionalElection: Regional election calendars vary by autonomous community; the next common regional cycle is in 2027.

politics.government: Brothers of Italy + League + Forza Italia, with Us Moderates in government.
politics.support: Coalition government with a parliamentary majority.
politics.opposition: Main opposition includes Democratic Party and Five Star Movement.
politics.nationalElection: General election due no later than 22 December 2027.
politics.regionalElection: Regional and local elections follow separate calendars.

politics.government: Democratic Alliance government led by PSD with CDS-PP.
politics.support: Minority government following the 18 May 2025 legislative election.
politics.opposition: Chega and the Socialist Party are the largest opposition forces in parliament.
politics.nationalElection: Next legislative election on or before 14 October 2029, unless an earlier election is called.
politics.regionalElection: Azores and Madeira have separate autonomous-region election calendars.

politics.support: Parliamentary majority coalition formed after the 2023 election.
politics.opposition: Opposition includes LSAP, ADR, Greens, Pirates and The Left.
politics.nationalElection: Next legislative election in 2028; statutory deadline on or before 8 October 2028.
politics.regionalElection: No elected regional-government tier; communal elections are the relevant subnational cycle.
